business: Quarry Ridge Plastics, Inc. (Injection Moulding & Contract Manufacturing)

expectedRedFlags: One-time tooling and NRE revenue treated as recurring (buyer adjustment): Buyer-identified downward adjustment. Segment 4200 carries tooling and non-recurring engineering revenue earned once at the start of a programme. FY2025 included an unusually heavy tooling year, and roughly $138,000 of contribution will not repeat unless equivalent new programmes are won.
Customer concentration: Largest customer, Glacier Point Fabrication, is 24.0% of FY2025 revenue; top 5 are 72.9%.
expectedYellowFlags: Owner compensation above market: Partially supportable. About $198,000 of the $282,000 claim exceeds the cost of a plant manager to replace the owner's operating role.

Obsolete resin and finished-goods write-off: Partially supportable. A write-off occurs in this business most years. The FY2025 charge is larger than usual, so only the excess over the normal run-rate of roughly $59,000 is a genuine one-time item.

Resin commodity hedging loss: Unsupported. Account 6730 posts every month for three years. A standing hedging programme against resin price exposure is an ordinary and continuing cost of operating a moulding business.
Environmental permitting and stormwater compliance: Fully supportable. A discrete permit renewal and stormwater study in September and October 2025 with no other activity in the account.

Seasonality and net working capital swing: FY2025 monthly EBITDA ranges from $-50,229 to $165,348; cash ranges from $8,730,478 to $12,323,057. The NWC peg must be set on a 12-month average, not a period-end snapshot.
groundTruth.notes: MML M&A Benchmark Deal DD-015: Quarry Ridge Plastics, Inc. (Injection Moulding & Contract Manufacturing). Seller claims $2.16M EBITDA vs $1.50M buyer-supported ($651k overstatement).
